info.name: Public Prewave Actions EUDR - Customers - DDS API
Update a customer DDS for an inbound product

params.name: ddsId
params.description: ID of the customer DDS to update.

items.docs:
Updates an existing customer Due Diligence Statement (DDS) identified by `ddsId`.
The payload must contain all required customer, activity, and product measure fields.

**Use Cases**:
- Update compliance statements
- Modify due diligence information
- Correct DDS data before submission

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the DDS

info.name: Delete a customer DDS before successful submission

params.name: ddsId
params.description: ID of the customer DDS to delete.

items.docs:
Delete a customer Due Diligence Statement (DDS) while it is new or in submission-error state.

This endpoint permanently removes the specified customer DDS.
It cannot be used for DDS entries that have already been submitted or made available.
Use with caution as this operation cannot be undone.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and access to the DDS

info.name: Submit a customer DDS to TracesNT system

params.name: ddsId
params.description: ID of the customer DDS to submit.

items.docs:
Submits the specified customer Due Diligence Statement (DDS) to the TracesNT system for regulatory processing.
Returns `202 Accepted` if the request is successfully queued for processing.

**Use Cases**:
- Submit DDS to regulatory system
- Complete compliance workflow
- Register DDS with authorities

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the DDS

info.name: Fetch customer DDS entries for a product

params.name: productId
params.description: ID of the product for which to fetch customer DDS entries.

items.docs:
Returns all customer Due Diligence Statements (DDS) associated with the given inbound or outbound product.
Only accessible if the caller has read permission for the product.

**Use Cases**:
- View all customer DDS entries for a product
- Track compliance statements
- Review DDS history and submission status

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `READ` on the product

info.name: Create a new customer DDS for an inbound product

params.name: productId
params.description: ID of the product for which to create the customer DDS.

items.docs:
Creates a new customer Due Diligence Statement (DDS) for the specified inbound product.
The payload must contain all required customer, activity, and product measure fields.

**Use Cases**:
- Create compliance statements for products
- Document due diligence information
- Prepare DDS data before regulatory submission

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the product

params.name: ddsId
params.description: The ID of the DDS statement.

items.docs:
Withdraws a customer Due Diligence Statement (DDS) from the regulatory system.
The DDS must be in `Available` state, and the withdrawal must be requested no later than 72 hours after it becomes available.
The withdrawal is completed synchronously; a successful response means both the regulatory withdrawal and local state update completed.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the DDS

info.name: Fetch supplier DDS entries for a product

params.name: productId
params.description: ID of the product for which to fetch supplier DDS entries.

items.docs:
Retrieve all supplier Due Diligence Statements (DDS) associated with the specified product.

This endpoint returns all supplier DDS entries that have been submitted for the product,
including origin information provided by suppliers in response to origin requests.

**Use Cases**:
- View supplier DDS responses for a product
- Track supplier compliance data
- Review origin information from suppliers

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `READ` on the product

info.name: Retrieve all available DDS units along with their associated HS codes

items.docs:
Retrieve reference data for all available DDS units and their associated HS codes.

This endpoint returns all DDS units that can be used when creating or updating DDS entries,
along with the HS codes that are associated with each unit.

**Use Cases**:
- Get DDS unit reference data before creating a DDS
- Populate unit selection dropdowns
- Validate unit and HS code associations

**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

info.name: Delete a supplier DDS and its origins

params.name: ddsId
params.description: ID of the supplier DDS to delete.

items.docs:
Delete a supplier Due Diligence Statement (DDS) and all its associated origin information.

This endpoint permanently removes the specified supplier DDS and all related origin data.
Use with caution as this operation cannot be undone.

**Use Cases**:
- Remove incorrect supplier DDS entries
- Clean up duplicate DDS data
- Delete outdated compliance statements

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `DELETE` on the DDS
